youtube_title: Bailly Cemetery near Chesterton: the graveyard that was buried in sand
body: In Porter, next to Chesterton, there's a cemetery that was buried on purpose. Fur trader Joseph Bailly settled here in the 1820s, and neighbors, including Swedish immigrants, buried their dead on the same sand ridge. In the 1880s the family walled it in with six feet of stone topped with iron spikes. Around 1914, granddaughter Frances Howe hired a Chesterton builder to wrap the walls in concrete and fill the inside with sand. The family's graves are still under that sand, and on a copy of the plaque one letter is backward. It's part of Indiana Dunes National Park now, and a short trail leads up to it (check trail status at nps.gov/indu). 🪦 Comment your town, and it could be next! #Chesterton #Porter #IndianaDunes #PorterCounty #Indiana #History #LaPorteAfterDark
